```{r}
EE_main_ranks <- mapped_comp %>%
  filter(Label == "H_EE_vs_SH") %>%
  select(Protein, gene, log2FC, adj.pvalue) %>%
  mutate(arrow = if_else(log2FC > 0, "\u2191", "\u2193")) %>%
  arrange(adj.pvalue) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  mutate(sig = if_else(adj.pvalue <=0.05, "*", "")) %>%
  mutate(crank = paste0(arrow, " ", rank,sig))

EE_main_ranks_4_psum <- EE_main_ranks %>%
  select(Protein, gene, arrow:crank)
```

## Map/Fix names - aka + bunch of extra annotation info! + join EE

### For Protein Summarisation Data

```{r}
# Map details & shorten name
mapped_psum <- left_join(mapped_psum_v3.2.2_EExAge,
                                       anno,
                                       by = join_by(
                                         BioReplicate == BioReplicate,
                                         Mixture == Mixture,
                                         Channel == Channel)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Condition = Condition.x , Housing_c_anno = Condition.y) %>%
  mutate(Age = ifelse(PND > 100, "OLD", "YNG")) %>%
  mutate(Age = factor(Age, levels = c("YNG", "OLD"))) %>% # so YNG is 1st
  mutate(across(c(Housing, Sex, Year, Cohort, Litter, exp_helper),
         as.factor)) %>% # auto alphabetical order (not really needed?)
  
  left_join(ref_rat_trm, by = join_by("Protein" == "Entry")) %>%
  left_join(EE_main_ranks_4_psum,
            by = join_by("Protein" == "Protein", "gene" == "gene"))
```

### For Group Comparison Data

```{r}
# shorten name & clean up! 
mapped_comp <- mapped_comp_v3.2.2_EExAge_t1 %>%
  
  filter(is.na(issue)) %>% # keeps rows with issue == na (so comps that are ok)
  filter(!str_detect(log2FC, "Inf")) %>% # remove infinity/missing FC values
  
  # make gene label for significant! 
  mutate(sig_g_label = if_else(adj.pvalue <= .05, gene, NA)) %>%
  
  # make one for no. of sig up & down for each comaprison group/label
  group_by(Label) %>%
  mutate(sig_no_up_lab = sum(adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC > 0), # up
         sig_no_down_lab = sum(adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC < 0)) %>%  #  down
  
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(log2FC > 0, "Up", "Down")) %>%
  
  left_join(ref_rat_trm, by = join_by("Protein" == "Entry")) %>%
  filter(!(Label %in% c("HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_OLD", "HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_YNG"))) # 6 plots

# check 
head(mapped_comp) 
colnames(mapped_comp)
dim(mapped_comp) # 64384 x 22

unique_check_mapcomp <- mapped_comp %>% 
  dplyr::select(Label, sig_no_down_lab, sig_no_up_lab) %>%
  unique() # yep matches up! 
```

# Themed PhD PSUM plots

Just doing nooby manual way for now

- <https://forum.posit.co/t/reordering-plot-based-on-another-dataframe/26467/3>

#### psum theme

```{r}
my_psum_facet_theme <- 
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color ="grey10"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color ="grey10"),
    axis.title.y= element_text(size = 8, color ="grey10"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    
    panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "cm"),  # Removes space between panel 
    legend.title = element_text(color = "grey10", face = "italic",  size = 9),
    legend.margin = margin(-5,0,0,0), # space between plot & legend
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"), # size of legend key icon,
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .1, colour = "grey15"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA,color = "grey10",linewidth = 0.3), #plot bord
    strip.background = element_rect(color = 'grey10',
                                    fill = 'grey90',linewidth = .25),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9.5, color = "grey10"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11.5,  color = "grey10",face = "italic"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9,  color = "grey10",face = "italic"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.15),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.15),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
